cases.translation: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

cases.translation: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

cases.explain: «неразумный человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
